name: AJI
recent: Ajinomoto (Malaysia) 在 2026 年 9 月 24 日召开第 65 届年度股东大会和特别股东大会，股东批准了母公司 RM20 的私有化选择性资本回退与偿还（SCR）方案。公司于 11 月 27 日宣布更换公司秘书，并发布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上批准了母公司 RM20 的私有化选择性资本回退与偿还（SCR）方案。
第 65 届年度股东大会的所有决议均获通过，包括董事费、董事福利及董事连任。
公司宣布更换公司秘书，Yee Kit Yeng 卸任。

news.title: Waspada, IHSG Rawan Terkoreksi Hari Ini
Ajinomoto Malaysia shareholders approve parent’s RM20 privatisation offer

recent_en: Ajinomoto (Malaysia) held its 65th AGM and EGM on 24 September 2026, where shareholders approved the parent company's RM20 privatisation via selective capital reduction and repayment (SCR). The company announced a change of company secretary on 27 November and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the parent company's RM20 privatisation via selective capital reduction and repayment (SCR) at the EGM.
All resolutions at the 65th AGM were passed, including directors' fees, benefits, and re-election of directors.
